main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-7-bar excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid cells)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 and mean excess > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope t <= -2 or mean-excess t <= -2; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean next-7-bar excess return, same-day cases summed (t >= 2, > 0)

decided_by: Neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met (slope t between -2 and 2, or positive slope with mean-excess t under 2).
reading: Grid cells at positions 0,7,14,... of each window with a full 7-bar forward return; the coin's mean 7-bar return is over all its grid cells in all windows; the slope is a pooled OLS across coins on per-cell values (not day-summed), while the mean-excess t uses same-day sums; the 100-case minimum counts positive-forecast cells and, being a minimum count, gives 'not observable'.
